_help: The Great Stump hides somewhere in the forest (2x2 tiles). Chop your way to it and leave a fruit offering: each evening between arriveHours there's a chance (better fruit, better odds) that a spirit animal comes to visit. While it's there the cats work faster; when it leaves it may leave a gift. Hours are the in-game clock (real time).

stump._depth: How many forest tiles deep it hides from open ground when a world is made.

offering._chance: Chance each evening = base + fruit price x perPrice (an apple, price 22, is about 43%; a fig, 48, about 63%). The offering stays until a spirit comes.

fox.name: Fox Spirit
fox.desc: A quick, curious spirit wreathed in blue flame.

moose.name: Moose Spirit
moose.desc: An ancient guardian of the woods. Rarer, and more generous.
